body:
**Should-fix:** this stamp check only runs from the header `onBackPress` handler.

Native-stack iOS edge-swipe and Android hardware back still go through React Navigation `goBack()`, which remains parent-aware. On a single-entry Perps stack after Home was dropped, that still pops `PERPS.ROOT` out to wallet — the same TAT-3786 failure, just not via `<`.

Please intercept `beforeRemove` / Android `BackHandler` (or disable the pop gesture on this screen) and apply the same `hasPerpsStackHistory` / `wasPerpsHomeDroppedFromHistory` / `backFallback` logic.
action: Intercept GO_BACK/POP in beforeRemove and apply the dropped-Home fallback.

body:
**Should-fix:** list back is still `perpsNavigation.navigateBack` (`handleBackPressed`) and does not read `homeDroppedFromHistory`.

After Lite → Pro, `dropPerpsHomeFromStackHistory` can leave `[MARKET_LIST, MARKET_DETAILS]`. Back from the market pops to the list; back from the list then pops `PERPS.ROOT` to wallet.

When the list is the only remaining Perps route and the stamp is present, use the same header fallback (`navigateToHome` / `navigateToWallet`) instead of parent-aware `goBack()`.
action: List back now uses shouldPopPerpsRoute; remaining dropped-Home list uses home/wallet fallback.

body:
**Should-fix:** `preserveHomeDroppedFromHistory` is only applied on this `replaceOnSelect` reset.

The non-replace path still does `StackActions.push(Routes.PERPS.MARKET_DETAILS, detailsParams)` with unstamped params. A later focused market with no Perps history then looks like an Explore entry and the new back check pops out of Perps.

Stamp the pushed params the same way as this replace.
action: Stamp StackActions.push MARKET_DETAILS params with preserveHomeDroppedFromHistory.

body:
**Should-fix** (`app/components/UI/Perps/types/navigation.ts`)

`homeDroppedFromHistory` is not on `PerpsMarketDetails` (or the other routes this PR stamps). Extra params will keep compiling, which is how Home→Pro resets and the header picker replace already dropped the stamp.

Please add the flag to `PerpsStackParamList` (at least `PerpsMarketDetails`, and any other route `dropPerpsHomeFromStackHistory` / `withHomeDroppedFromHistory` writes) so new resets and pushes cannot omit it silently.
action: Added homeDroppedFromHistory?: true to PerpsMarketDetails, PerpsMarketListView, and PerpsTrendingView.

body:
### Unstamped Home drop skips fallback

The new Back check pops the parent whenever `homeDroppedFromHistory` is missing. Only `dropPerpsHomeFromStackHistory` writes that stamp; the Home → Pro resets discard Home without it. After Home → Pro → Lite, Back calls `goBack()` and lands on wallet instead of Perps home.
action: Already fixed in an earlier commit; thread resolved and already replied.

body:
### Stamp lost after market replace

After Lite to Pro drops Home, `homeDroppedFromHistory` lives only on the current market route. The header market picker rebuilds `MARKET_DETAILS` without that param, so the new back check treats the stack as an Explore entry and pops out of Perps instead of using the Lite `home` fallback.
action: Already fixed by preserveHomeDroppedFromHistory on replace; thread resolved and already replied.

body: Flaky unit test detection: J4 PerpsMarketListView waitFor without assertion; J4 PerpsModeSelectionView Promise.resolve; J4 usePerpsProMarketHeaderActions act(); J3 perpsModeSwitch missing resetAllMocks.
action: All four findings are false positives: no empty waitFor, Promise.resolve is a microtask flush, act() is required, clearAllMocks is the correct reset.
